tools.name: parse_phone_number
tools.description: Validate one phone number offline against libphonenumber metadata and return E.164, international, national and RFC 3966 formats, region, calling code and line type (from the original allocation). Valid means the number fits an allocated range, not that the line is connected or reachable; no carrier

tools.name: get_example_number
tools.description: Return the libphonenumber example (mobile) number for a region, in all formats, for format testing only (do not dial). Read-only. Same data and limits as GET /v1/example/{country}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: parse_phone_number · Public sink: parse_phone_number · Destructive: get_example_number.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: parse_phone_number · Public sink: parse_phone_number · Destructive: get_example_number

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
